chk_dose_txn_has_event.name: chk_dose_txn_has_event
chk_dose_txn_has_event.value:
("medication_inventory_transaction"."transaction_type" IN ('dose_taken','dose_reversed') AND "medication_inventory_transaction"."dose_event_id" IS NOT NULL) OR
          ("medication_inventory_transaction"."transaction_type" NOT IN ('dose_taken','dose_reversed') AND "medication_inventory_transaction"."dose_event_id" IS NULL)

chk_anchor_matches_kind.name: chk_anchor_matches_kind
chk_anchor_matches_kind.value:
("medication_schedule"."schedule_kind" = 'prn' AND "medication_schedule"."time_anchor" IS NULL) OR
          ("medication_schedule"."schedule_kind" IN ('daily','multiple_times_daily','specific_weekdays') AND "medication_schedule"."time_anchor" = 'wall_clock') OR
          ("medication_schedule"."schedule_kind" = 'every_n_hours' AND "medication_schedule"."time_anchor" = 'elapsed')

chk_item_has_label.name: chk_item_has_label
chk_item_has_label.value: "purchase_list_item"."user_medication_id" IS NOT NULL OR "purchase_list_item"."label" IS NOT NULL

chk_catalog_or_manual.name: chk_catalog_or_manual
chk_catalog_or_manual.value: "user_medication"."catalog_product_id" IS NOT NULL OR "user_medication"."custom_name" IS NOT NULL
